test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He was accused _______ theft.
solution:
The correct answer is '**of**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**of**" is used to indicate the object or cause of an accusation.
 
• In this sentence, "**theft**" is the object of the accusation, so "**of**" is the appropriate preposition.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **4** are incorrect because they do not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"He was accused **of**__ theft."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "with"** is incorrect because "accused with" is not a valid collocation in English.
 
• **Option 2: "by"** is incorrect because "accused by" would imply identifying the accuser, not the cause of the accusation.
 
• **Option 4: "for"** is incorrect because "accused for" does not convey the intended meaning in this sentence.
